name: gtsemverbundle
description: real esbuild 0.27 output (--bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax) of a TypeScript source over a CommonJS dependency with semver 6's load-time shape: `exports = module.exports = Version` first, then `var re=exports.re=[],src=exports.src=[],t=exports.tokens={},R=0;function tok(n){t[n]=R++}` and token calls, with the hoisted Version reading the token table
